body.name: second-order staircase alignment handle
body.construction: Expand the Choi--Yuan block KKT equations and debiasing map exactly to second order on balanced rank-one complete triangular arrays in \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\), retain signed singular-space perturbations before applying norm inequalities, align their signs across nested adoption blocks, and optimize the resulting per-law quantiles over the explicitly defined finite slices to derive a primitive expression \(\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\) equivalent to \(\Delta_n^*(K;\eta_n)\).
